verdict.rationale: Smithery documents Triggers: a consumer activates a trigger through Smithery, the subscribe call is proxied to the MCP server, and the server then POSTs events directly to the consumer. Trigger schemas also appear in the generated typed SDKs. This is webhook-style event subscription, but it only works for servers that implement triggers, Smithery is not in the delivery path, and no platform-level webhooks (e.g. for connection status changes) are evidenced. Missing for 10: platform-level webhook events, documented signing/retry/delivery guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration of trigger delivery.
